description: This file defines the 'Engine' class, which models the <engine> XML element in the OFBiz service configuration. It includes attributes like className, name, and a list of parameters, providing methods to access these properties.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: A class that models the <engine> element in the service configuration XML, encapsulating its attributes and parameters.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Engine object from an XML Element, extracting attributes and child parameter elements.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with this engine.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this engine.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a Parameter object by its name.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the list of all parameters.

methods.name: getParameterValue
methods.description: Returns the value of a parameter by its name.
